revision_signal: environment reward; reasoning-aware reward (Echo Trap diagnosis)
role_in_survey: multi-turn RL learning signals; shows belief/reasoning does not emerge from outcome reward alone
note: StarPO trajectory-level multi-turn RL with RAGEN system; identifies Echo Trap (reward-variance collapse) fixed by trajectory filtering and gradient stabilisation; finds reasoning hardly emerges without fine-grained reasoning-aware rewards.
title: RAGEN: Understanding Self-Evolution in LLM Agents via Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning

revision_signal: episode-level group reward plus step-level anchor-state grouping
role_in_survey: critic-free step-level credit assignment via repeated environment states
note: Two-level group advantage: trajectory groups for episode credit and anchor-state groups (repeated env states) for step credit; >12% over GRPO on ALFWorld and >9% on WebShop with Qwen models.
title: Group-in-Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training

revision_signal: environment feedback via API observations in POMDP
role_in_survey: POMDP formalisation of API agents; RL induces documentation-consulting and assumption-avoiding behaviours
note: Formalises interactive digital agents as POMDP and trains with LOOP, a memory-efficient PPO variant; 32B agent beats OpenAI o1 by 9 pp on AppWorld; agents learn to consult docs, avoid assumptions, recover from errors.
title: Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Interactive LLM Agents

revision_signal: retrieved documents interleaved with reasoning; outcome reward
role_in_survey: RL-learned evidence acquisition (search queries) with retrieved-token masking
note: Extends RL to interleave autonomous search-query generation with step-by-step reasoning; retrieved-token masking for stability and outcome reward; 41% (Qwen2.5-7B) and 20% (3B) gains over RAG baselines on seven QA datasets.
title: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning

revision_signal: search results inserted into reasoning chain; outcome reward
role_in_survey: search as part of reasoning chain learned by RL without supervised reasoning steps
note: Treats search operations as components of the reasoning chain and trains via RL with no supervised reasoning data on Qwen2.5-7B/32B; reflection and self-correction emerge during training.
title: ReSearch: Learning to Reason with Search for LLMs via Reinforcement Learning

revision_signal: internal state rewritten each turn consolidating new observations and pruning irrelevant content
belief_level_metrics: partial (memory usage / context size vs accuracy)
role_in_survey: RL-learned constant-size internal state as compressed belief
note: RL trains agent to overwrite a shared internal state that serves both memory consolidation and reasoning; MEM1-7B improves performance 3.5x while cutting memory 3.7x vs Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on 16-objective multi-hop task.
title: MEM1: Learning to Synergize Memory and Reasoning for Efficient Long-Horizon Agents

revision_signal: chunk-wise overwrite of fixed-size memory as document is streamed
role_in_survey: RL-trained overwrite memory over streamed evidence (multi-conv DAPO)
note: Reads text in chunks and updates a fixed memory via overwrite; multi-conv extension of DAPO trains the update policy; trained at 32K it extrapolates to 3.5M tokens with <5% loss and >95% on 512K RULER.
title: MemAgent: Reshaping Long-Context LLM with Multi-Conv RL-based Memory Agent

revision_signal: LLM-driven extraction, consolidation and update of memory entries per conversation turn
role_in_survey: production external memory with add/update/delete consolidation; graph variant
note: Extracts salient facts from conversation and consolidates them into a memory store (plus graph variant); 26% relative LLM-judge gain over OpenAI memory on LOCOMO with 91% lower p95 latency and >90% token savings.
title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory

revision_signal: environment feedback rewrites episodic case memory; learned case-selection policy
role_in_survey: memory-based online RL (M-MDP) as gradient-free belief revision
note: Memory-augmented MDP with neural case-selection policy; adaptation occurs by rewriting episodic case bank from environment feedback rather than updating LLM weights; 87.88% Pass@3 GAIA validation, 66.6% F1 on DeepResearcher.
title: Memento: Fine-tuning LLM Agents without Fine-tuning LLMs

revision_signal: simulated-user utterances and API tool results across dialogue
role_in_survey: evaluation via end-state database comparison and pass^k reliability
note: Benchmark with LM-simulated users, domain APIs and policy rules; success judged by final database state and pass^k over repeated trials; GPT-4o solves <50% of tasks and pass^8 falls below 25% in retail.
title: tau-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains

revision_signal: user actions on shared environment observed only through dialogue (Dec-POMDP)
role_in_survey: dual-control Dec-POMDP evaluation where agent must infer and steer user-side state
note: Telecom domain modelled as Dec-POMDP with both agent and simulated user modifying environment; compositional task generator; performance drops when moving from no-user to dual-control setting.
title: tau2-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment

decision: exclude(no belief or memory mechanism; general long-horizon benchmark)
revision_signal: n/a
role_in_survey: peripheral: long-horizon work-task benchmark cited for context only
note: Simulated software company where agents browse, code and message colleagues; best agent completes 30% of tasks autonomously.
title: TheAgentCompany: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Consequential Real World Tasks

revision_signal: additional environment observations from longer interaction horizons
role_in_survey: test-time interaction scaling as information-gathering axis
note: Curriculum RL that adaptively lengthens rollouts so agents gather more environment evidence instead of only thinking longer; Gemma 3 12B achieves open-source SOTA on web navigation benchmarks.
title: Thinking vs. Doing: Agents that Reason by Scaling Test-Time Interaction

revision_signal: step-level critic reward using training-time privileged information
role_in_survey: turn-level credit assignment via asymmetric-information critic; ColBench
note: Critic trained with extra training-time information provides step-level rewards for multi-turn collaboration; 6% absolute improvement in success/win rate, Llama-3.1-8B matching GPT-4o on ColBench.
title: SWEET-RL: Training Multi-Turn LLM Agents on Collaborative Reasoning Tasks

revision_signal: outcome-supervised reward model; self-generated curriculum from failures
role_in_survey: self-evolving curriculum RL with learned outcome reward for web agents
note: Addresses task scarcity, sparse feedback and policy drift with self-generated curriculum, ORM and adaptive RL; Llama-3.1-8B 4.8% to 42.4% and GLM-4-9B 6.1% to 43% on WebArena-Lite.
title: WebRL: Training LLM Web Agents via Self-Evolving Online Curriculum Reinforcement Learning

revision_signal: token entropy spike after tool feedback triggers branched sampling
role_in_survey: entropy-adaptive rollout: uncertainty after evidence arrival drives exploration and step-level credit
note: Observes entropy rises right after tool calls; entropy-adaptive rollout mixes trajectory- and step-level sampling and uses advantage attribution; outperforms trajectory-level RL on 13 benchmarks with about half the tool-call budget.
title: Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization

revision_signal: frozen reflection model produces natural-language reflection on history each step
role_in_survey: two-player reflection-then-act online RL
note: Frozen reflection LM writes a reflection that conditions a policy LM trained with SFT then online RL, with negative-example generation and curriculum; GPT-2 XL 1.56B trained this way beats Mistral 7B.
title: Reflect-RL: Two-Player Online RL Fine-Tuning for LMs

revision_signal: environment observation triggers correction of erroneous action
role_in_survey: refinement tuning: learn to revise actions from observation
note: Synthesises trajectories where a strong LLM corrects wrong actions after environment feedback and fine-tunes on them; improves held-out generalisation and perturbation robustness and links generalisation to self-refinement.
title: AgentRefine: Enhancing Agent Generalization through Refinement Tuning

revision_signal: n/a
role_in_survey: neighbouring survey; POMDP framing of agentic RL and memory-as-capability taxonomy
note: Survey of 500+ papers framing agentic RL as temporally extended POMDPs with taxonomy over planning, tool use, memory, reasoning, self-improvement, perception; useful for positioning this survey.
title: The Landscape of Agentic Reinforcement Learning for LLMs: A Survey

revision_signal: multi-agent debate (bull vs bear researchers) and risk-team review
role_in_survey: finance application: role-based multi-agent belief formation through debate
note: Trading firm simulated by analyst, researcher, trader and risk-management LLM agents that debate and synthesise views; reports gains in cumulative return, Sharpe ratio and max drawdown over baselines (no specific numbers in abstract).
title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework

revision_signal: incremental multi-turn information injection; includes updates and selective forgetting
belief_level_metrics: yes (accurate retrieval; test-time learning; long-range understanding; selective forgetting)
role_in_survey: benchmark that directly tests belief update and forgetting in memory agents
note: Converts long-context datasets into incremental multi-turn form and defines four competencies including selective forgetting; finds all tested memory agents fall short across the four competencies.
title: Evaluating Memory in LLM Agents via Incremental Multi-Turn Interactions

revision_signal: LLM-rated social goal completion used for imitation and self-reinforcement
role_in_survey: learning signal from LLM judge; evaluator overestimation finding
note: Behaviour cloning plus self-reinforcement on LLM-rated social interactions; 7B model matches GPT-4-based agent on goal completion but LLM evaluators overestimate trained agents.
title: SOTOPIA-pi: Interactive Learning of Socially Intelligent Language Agents

revision_signal: tool/environment feedback per interaction step; flexible context management
role_in_survey: step-native RL transition modelling with token- or step-level credit assignment
note: Framework treating each interaction step as the basic RL transition with an optimisation layer supporting token- or step-level credit assignment; arXiv title differs from GitHub title (Training Powerful LLM Agents with End-to-End RL).
title: Agent-R1: A Unified and Modular Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

revision_signal: induction of reusable workflows from successful past trajectories
role_in_survey: procedural memory: cross-episode workflow induction
note: Induces reusable task workflows from prior experience and supplies them to guide future actions; 24.6% and 51.1% relative success gains on Mind2Web and WebArena.
title: Agent Workflow Memory

revision_signal: hypotheses about other agents' strategies scored by prediction accuracy and refined
role_in_survey: explicit natural-language hypothesis maintenance over other agents (ToM as belief revision)
note: Theory-of-Mind module generates natural-language hypotheses about opponents, evaluates them by predicted behaviour and refines them; improves over LLM and RL baselines on Melting Pot with hypothesis evaluation critical in ablations.
title: Hypothetical Minds: Scaffolding Theory of Mind for Multi-Agent Tasks with Large Language Models
